root_cause_hypothesis: The case PASSED on its own terms: build 0 errors, 0 BP errors, and every virtual-entity marker survived deserialization (IsPublic=Yes, PublicEntityName=ConDemoVirtualSource, PublicCollectionName=ConDemoVirtualSources, EntityCategory=Master, PrimaryKey=EntityKey -> AxDataEntityViewKey[EntityKey] over SourceCode, i.e. NOT RecId), each re-read through the bridge and confirmed in the compiled runtime metadata (Contoso_AxDataEntityView.md). The grounded path held end to end with NO overwrite=true: table via action=create, index via action=modify/add-index, ReplacementKey via modify-property, entity and privilege via action=create. The defect this run exposes is the AxDataEntityView CREATE WRITER completeness, which a green build cannot see. The produced entity XML omits four elements present in 3236/3236 AxDataEntityView files in ApplicationSuite/Foundation: SourceCode (the entity class Declaration, public class X extends common), FieldGroups (the five standard groups including AutoIdentification with AutoPopulate=Yes, which our OWN knowledge base names as the natural-key mechanism: Use AutoIdentification field group for natural key, maps to AlternateKey), empty DeleteActions and StateMachines. The deserializer defaults them silently, so xppc and xppbp stay green while the object diverges from 100 percent of standard models and, critically, has no class declaration to host the postLoad/mapEntityToDataSource/validateWrite overrides any real entity eventually needs. There is also no grounded repair route: d365fo_file(action=modify, objectType=data-entity, operation=add-field-group) is rejected with -Operation add-field-group on object type data-entity is not supported by the bridge-, so an agent that notices the gap can only fix it by hand-editing XML or overwrite=true - the exact escape hatch the loop forbids. SECONDARY (honesty) defect in d365fo_file(action=modify, operation=add-index): the first call with allowDuplicates/alternateKey correctly reported both parameters as IGNORED and named the right ones - good, honest behaviour - but the re-run with the corrected indexAllowDuplicates/indexAlternateKey hit the by-NAME idempotency guard and changed nothing, while the top-line banner still read -add-index ... applied via IMetadataProvider.Update()-. Only the indented sub-line said -already present ... skipped (idempotent)-. An agent that trusts the banner ships a table WITHOUT its AlternateKey. AlternateKey=Yes was only obtained via remove-index followed by add-index. bp_clean scored 0 on 3 warnings that are all case-scope artifacts, not model errors: BPErrorPrivilegeNotCoveredByDuty (the privilege exists solely to clear the DataEntitySecurityPrivilegeCheck BP ERROR the case forbids; no duty/role is in scope), plus BPErrorDeveloperDocumentationNotDefined and BPErrorTableMissingFormRef on the table (no form in scope, and DeveloperDocumentation would need a fresh label, which trips the known labelc.exe defect). The instruction requires zero BP ERRORS, which was met exactly.
suggested_fix_area: 1) src/generators (shared AxDataEntityView XML builder behind d365fo_file action=create/generate): emit the entity SourceCode/Declaration (public class <Name> extends common), the five standard FieldGroups with AutoIdentification/AutoPopulate=Yes pre-populated from the keyFields argument, and empty DeleteActions and StateMachines, in the MS element order (Name, SourceCode, Label, [SubscriberAccessLevel], DataManagementEnabled, DataManagementStagingTable, EntityCategory, IsPublic, PrimaryKey, PublicCollectionName, PublicEntityName, DeleteActions, FieldGroups, Fields, Keys, Mappings, Ranges, Relations, StateMachines, ViewMetadata) - verified against ApplicationCommon/AxDataEntityView/AgentFeedEntity.xml. 2) Bridge modify dispatcher: support add-field-group / add-field-to-field-group for objectType=data-entity, or make the rejection point at a create-time property instead of dead-ending. 3) add-index modify path: when an index of that name already exists, UPDATE its properties (AlternateKey, AllowDuplicates, fields) instead of skipping; at minimum change the top-line banner from -applied via IMetadataProvider.Update()- to -no change (index already present)- so the success text matches reality.
